title: Hang a framed picture on a wall hook by the wire behind it, level, then let go
instruction: Hang the picture on the wall hook by its wire so it hangs straight, then let go.
context: Hanging a picture is one of the most familiar jobs in any home. Ability tested: carrying a wide, flat frame upright with two hands and landing its hidden wire on a hook by feel. The wire is behind the frame, so the frame is lowered until the slack wire drops over the hook. A wire caught off-centre hangs crooked; a push on a lower corner levels it. Held by one side alone, the frame swings round the grip.
setup: Cm from arm-base midpoint (x forward, y left, z up). Wall: white 12 mm MDF, 90x60 cm, face x 45, two 150 mm L-brackets clamped. Hook: OOK #533024 30 lb steel hanger (13x32 mm, 12 mm lip, 9 mm throat) at y 0, throat z 39. Frame: black plastic 30x40 cm, 25x22 mm rails, styrene front, 0.20 kg, y 0 leaning 25 deg on panel (bottom front x 26), facing arms. Back: two OOK #50206 D-rings (17.5 mm, 30 lb) 10 cm down, 2 cm in; 27 cm OOK #50112 #3 7-strand stainless wire (0.8 mm, 20 lb). Ready pose.
scoring: Tools: video, ruler, digital angle gauge or phone inclinometer on top rail. Judged after 2 s still (or at 45 s limit). 0 if frame within 5 mm of table, not hung in hook's throat by wire on both D-rings, not facing forward, any gripper/pad within 5 mm of frame, or top-rail tilt about wall normal >15.0 deg. 1.0 if tilt <=1.5 deg, bottom-back edge <=1.0 cm from panel, both grippers >=10 cm clear, frame and arms at rest. Else 0.5 (tilt >1.5-15.0 deg, gap >1 cm, gripper 5 mm-10 cm, or moving).
reset_notes: Lift the picture off the hook and stand it back on its bottom edge at y 0, leaning on the panel at 25 degrees (bottom front edge at x 26, marked with tape on the table), wire hanging in a loose V behind it. The hook is never moved.
fidelity: Frame: one rigid box, real size and 0.20 kg mass. Wire: chain of thirteen 2 cm rigid segments, 3 mm diameter and 60 g (real #3 wire: 0.8 mm, a few g) for stable contact, bending springs, no stretch or twist; each twisted end is a 6 mm, 30 g stub held at its D-ring by a symmetric 1500 N/m spring (~3 mm give hung). Hook: fixed 3-box steel shape (30 lb nail holds rigid), friction 0.4 so off-centre catches hang crooked. Scorer converts ObjectState.quat_xyzw (xyzw) to top-rail tilt angle.
